0022600144.text: Cleveland (3-1, on a three-game winning streak and 3-0 at home) visits Atlanta for its fifth game of the season, sitting second in the Central, half a game back, and fifth in the East. The Hawks (2-3) have lost three straight and are 0-2 at home, sitting seventh in the East and one game back in the Southeast, with Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot, fracture) out. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and their last meeting was an April 10, 2026 game in Atlanta that the Cavaliers lost 124-102; they have not played each other yet this season.
